name: No Time to Bleed
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level antipaladin 1, bloodrager 1, cleric/oracle 1, lathspell 1, magus 1, paladin 1, shaman 1, witch 1

CAST

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range self
Target you
Duration 1 round/level

DESCRIPTION

You shout out a declaration against bleeding and for the duration you are immune to hit point bleed damage and any such bleed effect you are currently suffering from ends. This does not heal any bleed damage taken prior to the spell being cast.

No Time to Bleed, Mass

School conjuration (healing); Level antipaladin 2, bloodrager 2, cleric/oracle 2, lathspell 2, magus 2, paladin 2, shaman 2, witch .

Targets one living creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart. and must include yourself
Saving Throw Fort negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as no time to bleed except it affects multiple creatures as noted above.
